usage: PROG enforce-integrity [-h] [--data-root DATA_ROOT]
 [--audit-filename AUDIT_FILENAME] [--dry-run]
 [--json] [--log-level {DEBUG,INFO,WARNING,ERROR}]

options:
 -h, --help show this help message and exit
 --data-root DATA_ROOT Path to the data root. Falls back to the OSM_POLYGON_DATA_ROOT
 environment variable.
 --audit-filename AUDIT_FILENAME
 Name of the audit JSON inside <data-root>/processed/integrity/.
 --dry-run Compute and report rejections without rewriting tables or writing the
 audit
 --json Print the report summary as JSON on stdout
 --log-level {DEBUG,INFO,WARNING,ERROR}
